_comment: Transformation notes for the Northgate Ed-Fi v5 -> Riverbend CC LIF draft, keyed by rule Name (the target path). Applied by scripts/generate-crosswalk-draft.py --notes so the notes travel inside the exchange bundle and land in the MDR's Notes fields. A string value is the rule's Notes; an object may carry Notes, SourceAttributeNotes (keyed by source UniqueName) and TargetAttributeNotes. Authored rules take the note as-is; generated rows (identity / EDUcore) keep their provenance text and get the note appended. Rules already carrying Notes in northgate-edfi-name-rules.json are not listed. Facts about Ed-Fi elements refer to the Ed-Fi Data Standard v5 Unified Data Model.
Assessment.identifier: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi AssessmentIdentifier (the assessment's own identifier, assigned by its owner). Produces a standalone Assessment object rather than part of Person.
Course.Identifier.identifier: REVIEW. Target resolved by UniqueName to the shared Identifier entity under Course, but the expression writes Person.Identifier, and the source is the identification *system* (StudentIdentificationSystem, e.g. District), not the code value (IdentificationCode). Inherited from the reference Ed-Fi rules; likely wrong on both ends.
Course.Identifier.identifierVerification: REVIEW. Same UniqueName ambiguity as Identifier.identifier: the expression writes Person.Identifier. The source, Ed-Fi PersonalInformationVerification (how the person's identity was verified), is a reasonable semantic match for identifierVerification once the target is fixed.
Course.courseBeginDate: Session dates stand in for course dates: Ed-Fi carries BeginDate/EndDate on the Session (term), not on Course. Exact for a single-session record; with several sessions the translator's merge keeps one.
Course.courseEndDate: Session dates stand in for course dates: Ed-Fi carries BeginDate/EndDate on the Session (term), not on Course. Exact for a single-session record; with several sessions the translator's merge keeps one.

Course.identifier.Notes: Ed-Fi CourseCode (the district-assigned code, e.g. MATH-301) becomes the LIF course identifier, nested under Person.CourseLearningExperience so the course rides with the learner. Known limit: more than one Ed-Fi Course row makes the translator emit a list-valued Person and drop sibling fields.

SourceAttributeNotes.Course.CourseCode: Unique only within the education organization that assigned it; not a state or CIP code.

Course.name: Direct copy of Ed-Fi CourseTitle into the nested Person.CourseLearningExperience.Course. Same multi-row limit as Course.identifier.
Person.Contact.Address.addressCountyName: Direct copy of Ed-Fi Address.NameOfCounty. Ed-Fi also carries CountyFIPSCode; its LIF target (Person.Residency.countyFIPSCode) is not in Riverbend's profile, so the code is dropped.
Person.Contact.Address.addressLine2: Ed-Fi splits the second address line into ApartmentRoomSuiteNumber and BuildingSiteNumber; only ApartmentRoomSuiteNumber is carried, BuildingSiteNumber is dropped.
Person.Contact.Address.addressPostalCode: Direct copy. Ed-Fi PostalCode is a string, so ZIP+4 values pass through unchanged.
Person.Contact.Address.addressState: Ed-Fi carries the two-letter USPS abbreviation (StateAbbreviationDescriptor) while Riverbend's profile expects the full state name, so the EDUcore-derived lookup expands GA -> Georgia. Abbreviations missing from the lookup become null rather than passing through.
Person.Contact.Address.addressStreet: Direct copy. Ed-Fi StreetNumberName is the combined house number and street name, which is what LIF addressStreet holds.
Person.Contact.Address.addressType: Ed-Fi AddressTypeDescriptor values (e.g. Home, Mailing, Physical) copied verbatim; no value lookup because addressType has no controlled list in Riverbend's profile.
Person.Contact.Address.dateEffective: REVIEW. Ed-Fi Address.Period is a complex element (BeginDate/EndDate), not a date; this rule copies the whole object. Should read Period.BeginDate. Inherited from the reference Ed-Fi rules.
Person.Contact.Address.dateExpired: REVIEW. Ed-Fi Address.Period is a complex element (BeginDate/EndDate), not a date; this rule copies the whole object. Should read Period.EndDate. Inherited from the reference Ed-Fi rules.
Person.Contact.Address.latitude: Direct copy of Ed-Fi Address.Latitude, a string in the Ed-Fi model; no numeric conversion.
Person.Contact.Address.longitude: Direct copy of Ed-Fi Address.Longitude, a string in the Ed-Fi model; no numeric conversion.
Person.Contact.Email.emailAddressType: Ed-Fi ElectronicMailTypeDescriptor values (e.g. Home/Personal, Work, Organization) copied verbatim; no value lookup.
Person.Contact.Email.primaryEmailAddress: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi boolean.
Person.Contact.Telephone.doNotPublishInd: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi boolean.
Person.Contact.Telephone.orderOfPriority: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi integer ranking among the person's telephone numbers.
Person.Contact.Telephone.telephoneNumber: Direct copy. Ed-Fi TelephoneNumber is free-format text; dashes, spaces and country codes are not normalized.
Ed-Fi TelephoneNumberTypeDescriptor values (e.g. Home, Mobile, Work) copied verbatim; no value lookup.
Person.Contact.Telephone.textMessageCapa: Direct copy of the Ed-Fi boolean.

SourceAttributeNotes.Student.MiddleName: Optional in Ed-Fi; when absent the initials collapse to two letters.
